title: An item filed into an active sprint starts as todo
goal: backlog.py new with --sprint naming an active sprint writes the item as todo, not draft, so a bug found during a sprint is ready without a hand edit of its JSON; into a planned sprint it stays draft.
notes: From the retrospective of SP-fep4fpsx “Windows ready”: all five bugs filed into that active sprint (BG-wrdjwayg, BG-vdqfhc3d, BG-bn5zvau7, BG-tlubx3fz, BG-xue7xm6y) came out of backlog.py new as draft and needed a hand edit of their JSON to todo before claim.
